lines.en: label toukaspring4:
scene toukadownstairs1
We’re ushered through a winding hallway toward a set of stairs that seldom sees sentience. Each step feels like a promise. Each promise is immediately broken.
lines.zh: 我们被领着穿过一条蜿蜒的走廊，朝一段鲜有人迹的楼梯走去。每一步都像一个承诺。每个承诺又立刻被打破。

lines.en: I have trouble focusing on what exactly is happening. It all feels surreal. I’d resigned myself to the idea that this place was little more than a shell to house delusions in. Now the shell is gaining a mind of its own.
lines.zh: 我难以集中精神弄清到底在发生什么。一切都感觉不真实。我早已认命，以为这地方不过是个容纳妄想的空壳。可现在，这空壳开始有了自己的意识。

lines.en: The torches on the walls, rarely ever lit as I can only imagine, lock the eyes they shouldn’t have on me and ask me why I’m going along with this.
lines.zh: 墙上的火把——我猜它们极少被点燃——用本不该有的眼睛锁住我，质问我为什么要顺着这一切。

lines.en: It’s like they have seen what has transpired in the lower plane and want to silently talk me out of it. But I am unable to respond. I merely look at them and return the silence — asking why they care.
lines.zh: 仿佛它们见过「下层」发生的事，想无声地劝我收手。可我无法回应。我只是看着它们，报以沉默——反问它们为何在意。

lines.en: All the while, a hand rests on my shoulder and forces me down further, uncaring that the torches talk. And there is nothing I can do to change that as it stems from a mind with its roots already sunken in.
lines.zh: 自始至终，一只手搭在我肩上，逼我往下走，根本不管火把在「说话」。而我无力改变，因为这一切都源于一个早已「扎根」的头脑。

lines.en: The death grip they have on my legs makes it feel as if those arboreal veins have become the laces of my shoes — and they attempt to pull me down only to be met with instant gratification and prophesied success.
lines.zh: 它们攥住我腿的那股死劲，让人觉得那些树状的脉络变成了我的鞋带——它们想把我往下拽，却只换来「即时满足」和「命定的成功」。

lines.en: There is nothing I can do to stop what is coming. That is something I have resigned myself to as well. Long before I knew this place existed. Long before I knew {i}she{/i} existed.
lines.zh: 我无法阻止将要发生的事。这一点我也早已认命。早在我知道这地方存在之前，早在我知道{i}她{/i}存在之前。

lines.en: This peculiar half-mento. Those blinding blue eyes that can peer through my armor and dissolve my resolve.
lines.zh: 这个奇特的「半个引路人」。那双刺目的蓝眼睛，能看穿我的铠甲、瓦解我的决心。

lines.en: I want to break her open to see what’s inside. I can only imagine what colors would spill out.
lines.zh: 我想把她撬开，看看里面是什么。我只能想象会溅出什么样的颜色。

lines.en: : Almost there! Almost there!
lines.zh: : 快到了！快到了！

lines.en: scene toukadownstairs2
: Almost {i}where,{/i} Yasu? Are you escorting us to some sort of...ritualistic room? Where this apparent vow must take place?
lines.zh: : 快到{i}哪儿{/i}，Yasu？你是要带我们去什么……举行仪式的房间吗？那个所谓的「誓约」要在那儿完成？

lines.en: : Yes! Exactly! I heard Him just now, Touka! He told me where to take you! He says my wings are naught more than a whale away!
lines.zh: : 对！没错！我刚听见祂了，Touka！祂告诉我该带你们去哪儿！祂说我的翅膀离我只有「一头鲸鱼」那么远！

lines.en: : He measures things in whales?
lines.zh: : 祂用鲸鱼来量距离？

lines.en: : Whales, tails, the shells of snails! As pale as Michael’s bed of nails!
lines.zh: : 鲸鱼、尾巴，还有蜗牛的壳！苍白如 Michael 的钉床！

lines.en: scene toukadownstairs3
: Oh, why didn’t you just say so? I completely understand now.
lines.zh: : 哦，你早这么说嘛。我现在完全懂了。

lines.en: : Do {i}you{/i} understand as well, little lamb? Before we turn your legs to meat, you must feast on wheat! We beg you, eat!
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}也懂了吗，小羔羊？在把你的腿变成肉之前，你必须先吃点麦子！我们求你，吃！

lines.en: scene toukadownstairs4
: Silence, violence, noncompliance. How shall I guide who seeks no guidance?
lines.zh: : 沉默、暴力、不顺从。我该怎么引导一个不求引导的人？

lines.en: : I believe an effective place to start would be {i}not{/i} mentioning that you want to turn his lamb legs into meat.
lines.zh: : 我觉得有效的开场，是{i}别{/i}先提你想把他的「羔羊腿」变成肉。

lines.en: : Is this really part of the game, Yasu?
lines.zh: : 这真的是「游戏」的一部分吗，Yasu？

lines.en: : This {i}is{/i} the game.
lines.zh: : 这{i}就是{/i}游戏。

lines.en: scene toukadownstairs5
: {b}YOU ARE GOING TO HAVE SO MUCH FUN!{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}你们会玩得超开心的！{/b}

lines.en: scene toukadownstairs6
: What...{i}is{/i} this, Yasu?
lines.zh: : 这……{i}是{/i}什么，Yasu？

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure it’s a jail cell.
lines.zh: : 我很确定这是间牢房。

lines.en: : I’m aware of what it {i}appears{/i} to be. But I don’t believe that churches typically double as prisons.
lines.zh: : 我看得出它{i}像{/i}什么。但我不相信教堂通常还兼作监狱。

lines.en: : This is no prison. This is salvation.
lines.zh: : 这不是监狱。这是救赎。

lines.en: scene toukadownstairs7
: This is a chance to be reborn!
lines.zh: : 这是一个重生的机会！

lines.en: scene toukadownstairs8
: Why you- Yasu! What the hell do you think you’re doing?! Unlock this blasted cell at once! You said you were bringing us here to make a vow! Not to keep us as prisoners!
lines.zh: : 你这个——Yasu！你到底想干什么？！马上把这破牢门打开！你说是带我们来立誓的！不是把我们当囚犯关起来！

lines.en: : You’re {i}not{/i} prisoners, Touka! Prisoners don’t have the luxury of deciding when to leave! {i}You{/i} do!
lines.zh: : 你们{i}不是{/i}囚犯，Touka！囚犯可没资格决定什么时候走！{i}你们{/i}有！

lines.en: : Excellent! I would like to leave now!
lines.zh: : 太好了！我现在就想走！

lines.en: scene toukadownstairs9
: Okay!
lines.zh: : 好啊！

lines.en: : Oh. Was it...was it really that easy?
lines.zh: : 哦。真的……真的就这么容易？

lines.en: : It will be! You just have to complete the vow.
lines.zh: : 会的！你只要完成誓约就行。

lines.en: scene toukadownstairs10
: Hah...fine.
lines.zh: : 哈……好吧。

lines.en: : I, Touka Tsukioka, hereby vow to not change my color and...whatever else I am supposed to vow to complete Yasu’s ritual. The end.
lines.zh: : 我，Touka Tsukioka，在此起誓：不改变我的颜色，还有……为了完成 Yasu 的仪式我该起誓的别的什么。完毕。

lines.en: : That’s not how the vow goes.
lines.zh: : 誓约不是那么念的。

lines.en: scene toukadownstairs11
: I don’t {i}know{/i} how the vow goes! You haven’t told me what I’m supposed to say!
lines.zh: : 我哪{i}知道{/i}该怎么念！你还没告诉我该说什么！

lines.en: : You’re not really supposed to {i}say{/i} anything. It’s about what you {i}do.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你其实不用{i}说{/i}什么。关键在于你{i}做{/i}什么。

lines.en: : Uh-oh.
lines.zh: : 不妙。

lines.en: : Well, what am I supposed to {i}do{/i} then?!
lines.zh: : 那我该{i}做{/i}什么？！

lines.en: scene toukadownstairs12
: Make a baby!
lines.zh: : 造个宝宝！

lines.en: scene toukadownstairs13
: I’ll give you two some privacy! Bye!
lines.zh: : 我给你们俩留点私人空间！拜！

lines.en: scene toukadownstairs14
: Privacy, my ass! Get back here you little evangelist! I am {i}not{/i} losing my virginity in a dungeon!
lines.zh: : 私人空间个鬼！给我回来，你这个小传教士！我可{i}不{/i}要在地牢里失身！

lines.en: : So, it appears that I may have been wrong when I said that we should just go along with her to see what happens.
lines.zh: : 那么，看来我说「顺着她看看会怎样」可能是错了。

lines.en: scene toukadownstairs15
: You think?!
lines.zh: : 你说呢？！

lines.en: : Yeah. At the same time, though, now I finally get a chance to grope you. So that’s cool.
lines.zh: : 是啊。不过与此同时，我现在终于有机会摸你了。所以挺不错的。

lines.en: : How can you make jokes at a time like this?! We’re trapped in a dungeon and apparently not allowed to leave until I’m pregnant!
lines.zh: : 这种时候你怎么还开得起玩笑？！我们被困在地牢里，而且显然不怀孕就不许出去！

lines.en: : Yeah, but you’re the one who has to carry the child. Not me.
lines.zh: : 是啊，不过怀孕的人是你。不是我。

lines.en: : I will murder you!
lines.zh: : 我要杀了你！

lines.en: : Touka, relax. Yasu’s not even here. We can just tell her we had sex and she’ll just...go along with it whenever she gets back, probably.
lines.zh: : Touka，放松。Yasu 根本不在这儿。我们回头只要跟她说我们做过了，等她回来她多半……会信的。

lines.en: scene toukadownstairs16
: Yes, because hiding the truth from a girl who can see into the future {i}and{/i} past is a thing that can definitely be done.
lines.zh: : 对，因为对一个能看见未来{i}和{/i}过去的女孩隐瞒真相，这种事「绝对办得到」。

lines.en: : Use your phone to call for help then. Or try and squeeze through the bars. You’re small enough. You probably can if I give you a push.
lines.zh: : 那你用手机打电话求救。或者试试从栏杆中间挤出去。你够瘦。我推你一把，你多半能过去。

lines.en: scene toukadownstairs17
: I...suppose that may be possible. This entire situation is just frustrating to me.
lines.zh: : 我……想那或许可行。只是这整个状况让我很挫败。

lines.en: : I tried so hard to create an environment in which Yasu can feel {i}normal{/i} again only to be given the harshest possible reminder of {i}why{/i} we decided to medicate her in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我费了那么大劲给 Yasu 营造一个能让她重新「{i}正常{/i}」的环境，结果却换来最狠的提醒——提醒我们当初{i}为什么{/i}要给她用药。

lines.en: : It’s one thing to be impulsive. But to throw people who care about you into situations like this is-
lines.zh: : 冲动是一回事。可把在乎你的人卷进这种局面，就是另一回事了——

lines.en: : It’s like it’s not her at all, right?
lines.zh: : 感觉那根本不是她了，对吧？

lines.en: scene toukadownstairs18
: She was fine just hours ago...
lines.zh: : 几小时前她还好好的……

lines.en: : It wasn’t until you were brought into the picture that she started going off the rails again. I just...don’t understand what is going on between you two. How can you affect her so dramatically?
lines.zh: : 是你一掺和进来，她才开始失控的。我只是……搞不懂你们俩之间到底怎么回事。你怎么能把她影响得这么厉害？

lines.en: : That’s what I want to know too because there clearly is {i}some{/i} sort of merit to it. I can’t just ignore it and call her crazy anymore.
lines.zh: : 这也是我想知道的，因为这里面显然{i}有点{/i}名堂。我没法再无视它、随口说她疯了。

lines.en: scene toukadownstairs19
: So, what’s the plan then? Humor her and just...sit down here, wait until she comes back, then inform her that I’m carrying your child?
lines.zh: : 那现在怎么办？顺着她，然后……就坐在这儿等她回来，再告诉她我怀了你的孩子？

lines.en: : If you really want to sell it, you can make some really loud sex noises. Then she {i}really{/i} wouldn’t be able to deny that we did it.
lines.zh: : 你要真想演得逼真，可以发出很响的叫床声。那样她就{i}真{/i}没法否认我们做过了。

lines.en: scene toukadownstairs20
: Or we can just actually do it.
lines.zh: : 或者我们干脆真做一次。

lines.en: : That was obviously a joke.
lines.zh: : 那明显是开玩笑。

lines.en: : It wasn’t that obvious.
lines.zh: : 也没那么明显。

lines.en: scene toukadownstairs21
: May I offer you a seat?
lines.zh: : 我能请你坐吗？

lines.en: : May I offer {i}you{/i} one? On my penis?
lines.zh: : 我能请{i}你{/i}坐吗？坐我阴茎上？

lines.en: scene black
: No, I think the mattress will be just fine.
lines.zh: : 不了，床垫就行。

lines.en: : You’d be humming a different tune if we were in your oversized bedroom, I bet.
lines.zh: : 我敢打赌，要是在你那间大得离谱的卧室里，你哼的就是另一支调子了。

lines.en: scene toukadownstairs22
: Probably a lullaby since I’m effectively your mother and whatnot.
lines.zh: : 多半是摇篮曲，毕竟我实际上是你母亲之类的。

lines.en: : Are you really going to sit like that?
lines.zh: : 你真要那么坐？

lines.en: : Yes. This is just how I sit. And I will not let the fact that I am in jail influence my dignity and refinement in any way.
lines.zh: : 对。我一向这么坐。我不会因为身陷囹圄，就有半分有损我的尊严和教养。

lines.en: : Suit yourself. Just think you might actually enjoy it if you try to relax a little.
lines.zh: : 随你。只是觉得你稍微放松点，说不定还真能享受一下。

lines.en: : In a {i}jail cell?{/i} With a man I have {i}feelings{/i} for? Have you gone mad?
lines.zh: : 在{i}牢房{/i}里？跟一个我{i}心仪{/i}的男人一起？你疯了吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. Quite a while ago, actually.
lines.zh: : 疯了。其实，早就疯了。

lines.en: : At least you’re honest. It’s quite irritating being one of the only people in this god-forsaken city with a level head.
lines.zh: : 至少你够坦诚。在这座天杀的城市里，做少数几个头脑清醒的人之一，可真让人恼火。

lines.en: scene toukadownstairs23
: How {i}does{/i} this all look to someone with a level head, exactly?
lines.zh: : 在一个头脑清醒的人看来，这一切{i}到底{/i}是什么样？

lines.en: : Like utter nonsense, that’s what. You’d think I’d be used to it by now. But apparently, even constant exposure to the abnormal can’t normalize it.
lines.zh: : 就是一派胡言。你会以为我早该习惯了。可显然，就算天天接触反常，也没法把它变正常。

lines.en: : It’s chaos every day in the outside world, and I’d be lying if I said I don’t miss my bubble at times. But I suppose there are pros to this sort of {i}exposure{/i} too.
lines.zh: : 外面的世界天天都是混乱，我要说我不想念我的「泡泡」，那是撒谎。不过我想，这种{i}「接触」{/i}也有它的好处。

lines.en: : I’m one of them, right?
lines.zh: : 我是其中之一，对吧？

lines.en: : Of course. Though, I will say that I like you more when we’re {i}not{/i} trapped in a jail cell together.
lines.zh: : 当然。不过我得说，{i}没被{/i}一起关在牢房里的时候，我更喜欢你。

lines.en: : We’re not {i}really{/i} trapped at all. We’re just playing charades and humoring your friend. Just like we were when she brought us down here.
lines.zh: : 我们{i}其实{/i}根本没被「困住」。我们只是在玩比手画脚、顺着你的朋友。就跟她把我们带下来时一样。

lines.en: : ...Yes. I suppose that’s right.
lines.zh: : ……是。我想也是。

lines.en: : But it doesn’t change that it {i}feels{/i} wrong.
lines.zh: : 可这改变不了「{i}感觉{/i}不对劲」这一点。

lines.en: scene toukadownstairs24
: Which is a feeling only exacerbated by the fact that one of her dolls is staring at us from across the hall.
lines.zh: : 而「她的一个玩偶正隔着走廊盯着我们」，只会让这种感觉更糟。

lines.en: : Which one do you think that is?
lines.zh: : 你觉得那是哪个？

lines.en: : Don’t ask me. I’m not the one who remembers their names.
lines.zh: : 别问我。我可记不住它们的名字。

lines.en: : Why do you think it’s down here?
lines.zh: : 你觉得它为什么在这儿？

lines.en: : If I had to take a wild guess, I imagine it’s due to some {i}other{/i} strange ritual or game Yasu’s schizophrenia has induced.
lines.zh: : 要我瞎猜的话，大概是 Yasu 的精神分裂引发的{i}另一场{/i}怪仪式或游戏。

lines.en: : You don’t actually think she has that, do you?
lines.zh: : 你不是真觉得她有病吧？

lines.en: : I...don’t. Not anymore at least. But when every doctor in Kumon-mi continues to land on that as the diagnosis, I find it easier to just go along with it than to come up with a {i}new{/i} term.
lines.zh: : 我……不觉得。至少现在不了。可当公文美的每个医生都一直给出这个诊断时，我发现顺着他们说，比另造一个{i}新{/i}词要省事。

lines.en: : On the bright side, though...the facility Yasu seems to have the most luck with has experienced such a thing before. Which is why I imagine we’ll keep going there from this point on.
lines.zh: : 不过往好处想……Yasu 最有「感应」的那家机构，以前也处理过这种情况。所以我想，今后我们会一直去那儿。

lines.en: : So long as they keep allowing me to sit in on her evaluations, that is.
lines.zh: : 只要他们还让我旁听她的评估就行。

lines.en: : Such a thing as...as Yasu? Really? How?
lines.zh: : 处理过……像 Yasu 这样的？真的？怎么会？

lines.en: : Patient confidentiality agreements unfortunately prevent me from knowing any more than the fact that they have seen someone else with her condition before.
lines.zh: : 很遗憾，「病人保密协议」让我没法知道更多——只知道他们以前见过一个跟她情况相同的人。

lines.en: : And I only know that in the first place because her doctor informed me.
lines.zh: : 而我能知道这一点，还是因为她的医生告诉了我。

lines.en: : Can’t you just...use your money and influence to extract that information from them if it means coming closer to a potential solution? For Yasu’s sake of course.
lines.zh: : 你就不能……动用你的金钱和人脉，把那个信息撬出来吗？万一这能离治好 Yasu 更近一步呢。当然是为了 Yasu 好。

lines.en: : Yes, Yasu’s sake. I’m sure your rampant curiosity has nothing to do with it.
lines.zh: : 对，为了 Yasu 好。我敢肯定跟你那旺盛的好奇心一点关系都没有。

lines.en: : Two birds. One stone.
lines.zh: : 一石二鸟。

lines.en: : Unfortunately, I’m not sure I could. I had a hard enough time just getting the staff to allow me to {i}watch.{/i} I imagine my mother would, though. She has connections there.
lines.zh: : 可惜，我不确定我办得到。光是让工作人员允许我{i}旁听{/i}，我就费了好大劲。不过我母亲大概办得到。她在那儿有关系。

lines.en: : That’s not surprising. She has connections everywhere.
lines.zh: : 不奇怪。她哪儿都有关系。

lines.en: scene toukadownstairs25
: Being the most powerful woman in the city has its perks.
lines.zh: : 做这座城市里最有权势的女人，就是有好处。

lines.en: : Think you can get her to pry a little bit for the sake of your friend? {i}And{/i} my curiosity?
lines.zh: : 你觉得你能让她为了你的朋友稍微疏通一下吗？{i}顺便{/i}满足我的好奇心？

lines.en: : Under normal circumstances, yes. But she’s been busier than normal lately thanks to...
lines.zh: : 正常情况下，能。可她最近比平常忙，因为……

lines.en: : Thanks to something I...am supposed to keep secret.
lines.zh: : 因为一件……我该保密的事。

lines.en: : Well, now I {i}have{/i} to know.
lines.zh: : 好，这下我{i}非知道不可{/i}了。

lines.en: : I’m afraid that telling you wouldn’t accomplish much in the grand scheme of things. If anything, I Imagine it might put all of us at risk, actually.
lines.zh: : 恐怕告诉你，对大局也没什么用。要说的话，我想那反而可能把我们所有人都置于险境。

lines.en: : “All of us” as in-
lines.zh: : 「我们所有人」是指——

lines.en: : My family, of course. This is a personal matter. One that you needn’t-
lines.zh: : 当然是指我家。这是私事。你不必——

lines.en: scene toukadownstairs26
: Do {i}you{/i} want to talk about it?
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}想谈谈吗？

lines.en: : Or should I just leave it alone?
lines.zh: : 还是我就此打住？

lines.en: : That’s a dirty move — placing your hand on my shoulder like that when you know you’re one of my weaknesses.
lines.zh: : 这招真卑鄙——明知道你是我的软肋之一，还偏要那么把手搭在我肩上。

lines.en: : One of my only specialties is exploiting those in every one. You’re one of the easiest, surprisingly. You’re too kind.
lines.zh: : 我仅有的几项专长之一，就是戳每个人的软肋。而你——意外吧——是最好对付的一个。你太善良了。

lines.en: scene toukadownstairs27
: Hm.
: You sound like my sister.
lines.zh: : 你这话听着像我妹妹。

lines.en: : Yeah, I can see Tsukasa saying something like that. I’m actually the type to capitalize on it, though. She doesn’t have the heart yet.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我想象得出 Tsukasa 说这种话。不过我才是那种会加以利用的人。她还没那份心性。

lines.en: : Oh, she has the heart. She’s extremely capable for her age. Which is...
lines.zh: : 哦，她有那份心性。以她的年纪，她能干得很。而这正是……

lines.en: : Precisely what...
lines.zh: : 这桩……

lines.en: scene toukadownstairs28
: This specific issue...entails.
lines.zh: : 特定的事……所牵扯的。

lines.en: scene toukadownstairs29
: What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 你什么意思？

lines.en: : Is something going on with Tsukasa?
lines.zh: : Tsukasa 出什么事了吗？

lines.en: : We...should probably...not discuss-
lines.zh: : 我们……恐怕……不该谈这个——

lines.en: scene toukadownstairs30
: Ah-
: Your secret’s safe with me.
lines.zh: : 你的秘密在我这儿很安全。

lines.en: : Why, that’s not true at all.
lines.zh: : 才怪，根本不是那么回事。

lines.en: : You’re the type of man who destroys everything he touches.
lines.zh: : 你是那种碰什么毁什么的男人。

lines.en: : There is {i}nothing{/i} that is safe with you.
lines.zh: : {i}没有什么{/i}在你这儿是安全的。

lines.en: : {i}This{/i} is.
lines.zh: : {i}这{/i}件是。

lines.en: : And why should I believe that?
lines.zh: : 我凭什么信你？

lines.en: : Because I know that revealing it to anyone will destroy my chances of ever getting you somewhere like this with your consent.
lines.zh: : 因为我知道，只要把它透露给任何人，我就永远没法在「你自愿」的前提下把你带到这种地方了。

lines.en: : You want me to...consent to being a prisoner?
lines.zh: : 你是想让我……自愿当个囚犯？

lines.en: : Mostly just...in a private room with me.
lines.zh: : 主要是……跟我单独待在一个房间里。

lines.en: : I see...
lines.zh: : 我明白了……

lines.en: : And you’re {i}really{/i} not at all disturbed by the fact that you see me as a matriarch?
lines.zh: : 那你{i}真的{/i}一点都不为「你把我当女家长看」而困扰吗？

lines.en: : You’re more disturbed by that than I am.
lines.zh: : 你比我更困扰。

lines.en: : That is true. I {i}am{/i} quite disturbed. But I supposed Oedipal complexes aren’t {i}exactly{/i} unheard of.
lines.zh: : 这倒是。我{i}是{/i}挺困扰的。不过我想，俄狄浦斯情结也不算稀罕。

lines.en: : You’re also not my real mother.
lines.zh: : 而且你又不是我亲妈。

lines.en: : What was your real mother like?
lines.zh: : 你亲妈是什么样的？

lines.en: scene toukadownstairs31
: Don’t change the subject. Tell me what’s going on.
lines.zh: : 别岔开话题。告诉我到底怎么回事。

lines.en: : Or what?...
lines.zh: : 不然怎样？……

lines.en: : I’ll have to force it out of you.
lines.zh: : 我就得逼你说出来。
: 怎么逼？……

lines.en: : Don’t know...
lines.zh: : 不知道……

lines.en: scene toukadownstairs32
: Cute.
lines.zh: : 可爱。

lines.en: : So close to making me crumble, just to collapse yourself at the very end.
lines.zh: : 眼看就要把我逼到崩溃，结果到最后关头你自己先垮了。

lines.en: : I like you, Sensei...enough to open a window to my heart. But I’m afraid that I can’t open {i}any{/i} windows to my family until I know how serious you are.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢你，Sensei……喜欢到愿意为你在心上开一扇窗。但在弄清你有多认真之前，我恐怕没法为我的「家人」开{i}任何{/i}窗。

lines.en: : About what?
lines.zh: : 对什么认真？

lines.en: : What do you think?
lines.zh: : 你说呢？

lines.en: : {i}You?{/i}
scene toukadownstairs33
: I’ve already taken Yasu in...I have no qualms at all with...{i}taking you in{/i} too...
lines.zh: : 我已经收留了 Yasu……我完全不介意……把你也一并{i}收留{/i}……

lines.en: : You don’t really want a peasant like me. I’m just the closest you’ve ever had to someone who won’t put up with your shit.
lines.zh: : 你才不会真想要我这种平民。我只是你遇过的最接近于「不会忍你臭脾气」的人。

lines.en: scene toukadownstairs34
: You’ll put up with anything I want you to.
lines.zh: : 你会忍我让你做的任何事。

lines.en: : You might think you have a hold on me, Sensei...but {i}I’m{/i} the one who pulls the strings here.
lines.zh: : 你或许以为你攥住了{i}我{/i}，Sensei……可真正操纵线的人是我。

lines.en: : If I ask you to jump...you jump.
lines.zh: : 我叫你跳……你就跳。

lines.en: : If I ask you to beg...you beg...
lines.zh: : 我叫你求……你就求……

lines.en: scene toukadownstairs35
: If I ask you to {i}come...{/i}what do you do?
lines.zh: : 我叫你{i}来{/i}……你会怎么做？

lines.en: : Come...
scene toukadownstairs36
: Yeah?...
: You’d come for me?...
lines.zh: : 你会为我而来？……

lines.en: : Mhm...
lines.zh: : 嗯哼……
: 瞧见没？……

lines.en: : I have you wrapped around my finger...
lines.zh: : 我把你玩弄于股掌之间……

lines.en: : I’m the...one...who...
scene toukadownstairs37
: I’m suddenly...quite...dizzy...
lines.zh: : 我突然……好……晕……

lines.en: : Isn’t it rather...hot in here?...
lines.zh: : 这儿是不是……有点热？……

lines.en: : Tell me what to do...Touka...
lines.zh: : 告诉我该怎么做……Touka……

lines.en: scene toukadownstairs38
: Hah...hah...do I really have to spell it out for you?
lines.zh: : 哈……哈……非得我跟你明说吗？

lines.en: : Let’s give that fucking {i}god{/i} what he wants...
lines.zh: : 那我们就给那个该死的{i}神{/i}他想要的东西……

lines.en: : Yay!
scene toukadownstairs39
: Wha-
scene toukadownstairs40
: Y...Yasu! Open the door! We’ve been down here long enough!
lines.zh: : Y……Yasu！开门！我们在下面待得够久了！

lines.en: : Or just go back upstairs for a few minutes. That works too.
lines.zh: : 或者你先上楼待几分钟。那样也行。

lines.en: : Did you spill your seed inside of her body? Have the roots begun to grow? Is the vow complete?
lines.zh: : 你把你的种子播进她身体里了吗？根开始长了吗？誓约完成了吗？

lines.en: : No, I need more time.
lines.zh: : 没有，我还需要点时间。

lines.en: : L-Lies! I...am full of his seed as we speak! Even now, the...presence of light within me moves! I can feel it! It is...spectacular!
lines.zh: : 说——说谎！我……我说话这会儿已经满是他的种子了！就连现在，我体内的……「光之存在」都在动！我能感觉到！真是……太壮观了！

lines.en: scene toukadownstairs41
: I knew it! I knew you’d love it! Now, you can be happy! Now, an angel can be born! You shall name him Pahaliah! Just as He wants! Just as He says!
lines.zh: : 我就知道！我就知道你会喜欢！现在你可以幸福了！现在，一个天使可以诞生了！你要给他起名叫 Pahaliah！就如祂所愿！如祂所言！

lines.en: : Yes, yes! Whatever must be done! Now, release me so I can spread the word! Release me! Release me!
lines.zh: : 是，是！该做的我都会做！现在放我出去，好让我把这消息传扬开！放我出去！放我出去！

lines.en: scene black
: Okay, Touka! Here you go! I told you it was easy! I-
lines.zh: : 好的，Touka！给你！我就说很简单吧！我——

lines.en: scene toukadownstairs42
: How {i}dare{/i} you lock me in a cage like some sort of...animal! Even as part of a game, this was entirely unacceptable, Yasu! You know better than this!
lines.zh: : 你{i}竟敢{/i}把我像……牲口一样锁进笼子！就算是游戏的一部分，这也完全不可接受，Yasu！你明明懂分寸的！

lines.en: : You...
: You lied to me?...
lines.zh: : 你骗了我？……

lines.en: scene toukadownstairs43
: Nothing grows inside of you...there is no light to be delivered...
lines.zh: : 你体内什么都没在长……没有「光」要降生……

lines.en: : Yes! I {i}did{/i} lie! Just like {i}you{/i} lied when you said we could choose when to leave!
lines.zh: : 对！我{i}就是{/i}骗了！就像{i}你{/i}说「我们能自己决定什么时候走」也是在骗人！

lines.en: scene toukadownstairs44
: I...was just repeating what I heard! I don’t know all the rules! The instructions are always different! I-
lines.zh: : 我……只是在重复我听到的！我又不知道全部规则！每次的指示都不一样！我——

lines.en: : I don’t care! I will humor you as often as you want! I will take you here to {i}communicate!{/i} But I will not allow you to take advantage of my kindness and treat me like a toy for your god! Do you understand?!
lines.zh: : 我不管！你想让我顺着你多少次都行！我会带你来这儿{i}「沟通」{/i}！但我不许你利用我的善意、把我当成你那个神的玩具！你明白吗？！

lines.en: scene toukadownstairs45
: I don’t understand anything...
lines.zh: : 我什么都不明白……

lines.en: scene toukadownstairs46
: I don’t understand anything! I’m a useless messenger! A broken doll! I don’t deserve your kindness! I don’t deserve your love!
lines.zh: : 我什么都不明白！我是个没用的信使！一个坏掉的玩偶！我不配得到你的善待！我不配得到你的爱！

lines.en: : Wait! No! Don’t cry! I didn’t mean it! It’s just...locking people in cells is {i}wrong,{/i} Yasu! You can’t do that no matter {i}what{/i} you hear! Okay?
lines.zh: : 等等！不！别哭！我不是那个意思！只是……把人锁进牢房是{i}错的{/i}，Yasu！不管你听到了{i}什么{/i}，都不能那么做！好吗？

lines.en: : I just...want...to...save you! I’m sorry, Touka! I’m sorry, Sensei! I’m a failure! I’m a worm! I’m not fit for ascension!
lines.zh: : 我只是……想……救你！对不起，Touka！对不起，Sensei！我是个废物！我是条虫！我不配「升天」！

lines.en: : Yeah...yelling at her probably wasn’t the best move.
lines.zh: : 是啊……冲她大吼大概不是最好的做法。

lines.en: scene toukadownstairs47
: Oh, well you’re just {i}full{/i} of excellent advice today, aren’t you?!
lines.zh: : 哦，你今天可真是{i}满嘴{/i}金玉良言啊，是吧？！

lines.en: : AaaAaaAaHHH!! AAAaaAAAAAHHHHH!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊！！啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！

lines.en: scene black
: Yasu! No crying! Okay? Come with me. Back upstairs. We’ll get you home and into bed. Okay? Okay??
lines.zh: : Yasu！不许哭！好吗？跟我来。回楼上去。我们带你回家、让你上床睡觉。好吗？好吗？？

lines.en: : Aaahhh...AaaaAAhh...Aaaahhhh....
lines.zh: : 啊……啊啊啊……啊啊啊啊……

lines.en: : Sensei, would you mind-
lines.zh: : Sensei，你能不能——

lines.en: : I’ll leave, yeah. Being around me is...clearly not healthy for her.
lines.zh: : 我走，行。待在她身边……显然对她不好。

lines.en: : Thank you...and...
lines.zh: : 谢谢……还有……

lines.en: : About that...issue I mentioned...could you please not bring it up to my mother? The idea of the two of you communicating behind my back is...well, disturbing enough to me as-is.
lines.zh: : 关于我刚才提的那件……事……你能不能别跟我母亲提？光是想到你们俩背着我私下通气，就已经……够让我不安的了。

lines.en: : Yeah. I understand.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我明白。

lines.en: : Get Yasu home safe, okay? And Yasu — thanks for showing me the color game. I had fun.
lines.zh: : 把 Yasu 安全送回家，好吗？还有，Yasu——谢谢你给我看「颜色游戏」。我玩得很开心。

lines.en: : {i}Sniff...{/i}you did?...
: Really?...
: Yeah...tell Etinsib Ziwa I’d like to actually speak with him some day. I’d like to learn more about what he knows.
lines.zh: : 嗯……替我跟 Etinsib Ziwa 说，我想找个机会跟他当面聊聊。我想多了解点他知道的东西。

lines.en: : {i}Sniff...{/i}okay...I’ll tell him...
lines.zh: : {i}抽噎{/i}……好……我会告诉他的……

lines.en: : Say goodnight, Yasu. We have to get you home.
lines.zh: : 说晚安，Yasu。我们得带你回家了。

lines.en: : Goodnight...Sensei...
lines.zh: : 晚安……Sensei……

lines.en: : Goodnight...both of you.
lines.zh: : 晚安……你们俩。

lines.en: I leave the cathedral before either of them have the chance to follow me out.
lines.zh: 我没等她们俩来得及跟出来，就先离开了大教堂。

lines.en: The torches ignore me this time. So do the walls. So does everything.
lines.zh: 这次火把没理我。墙也没理我。什么都没理我。

lines.en: But there is a single rabbit doll I pass by on my way out of the building with eyes like stained glass that follow me all the way home.
lines.zh: 只有我走出大楼时路过的一只兔子玩偶，用那双彩色玻璃般的眼睛，一路跟着我回了家。

lines.en: I can feel them even now that I’m lying here in bed — burning holes through the body that sleeps beside me on the way to my chest.
lines.zh: 就算此刻我躺在床上，我也还能感觉到它们——烧穿睡在我身旁的那具身体，直抵我的胸口。

lines.en: I imagine they won’t ever leave.
lines.zh: 我想它们永远不会离开。

lines.en: I imagine they can’t.
lines.zh: 我想它们也离不开。

lines.en: I imagine I’m asleep.
lines.zh: 我想我睡着了。

lines.en: I am.
lines.zh: 我确实睡着了。

lines.en: $ toukaspring4 = True
$ touka_love += 1
{i}Touka’s affection has increased to [touka_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Touka 的好感度上升到了 [touka_love]！{/i}
